set.body: Outcome: a researcher can prepare UTF-8 recall transcript files and run the existing common study pipeline with deterministic segmentation, exact canonical UTF-16 spans, source hashes and recipe provenance. Scope: pipeline agentmapping preparation/export/bundle and Python reader, guide, tests and evidence. Preserve legacy supplied exports and bundle bytes; no new remote calls; no participant text committed. Acceptance: strict intake and tamper refusals, multiline/Unicode offsets, shared execution offline replay, supplied-vs-automatic differences kept separate from mapping accuracy, scoped fatal-warning tests and format, exact-SHA independent review. Non-goals: change segmentation heuristics or claim scientific accuracy. Risks: canonical/raw coordinate confusion, prompt line escaping and recipe spoofing. Next: finish bounded design review, reserve paths, implement.
set.title: Common study pipeline: ordinary transcript intake and auditable segmentation
